BiblicalUsage: theótēs stands behind the English phrase divinity, the godhead. In Colossians 2:9, in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
TheologicalSignificance: All the fulness of the Godhead dwelling bodily in Christ is the truth I lean on when I need God close, not far away.
